overview: Dialectica is a B2B information services firm that has grown from a small Athens-based startup in 2015 to one of the fastest-growing expert networks globally. The company's model is built on a key insight: replicate the high-touch, high-quality service model of premium competitors like AlphaSights, but run operations from Athens rather than London or New York — achieving comparable quality at significantly lower cost. This has fueled a 70% compound annual growth rate and revenue crossing $100 million. Dialectica is now pushing aggressively into AI with its Dialectica IQ knowledge graph, 50+ GenAI tools, and Origin deal-sourcing platform, while expanding its compliance infrastructure by hiring the former Tegus Chief Compliance Officer. The firm was upgraded to 'Global Leader' status by Inex One in 2024.

history.narrative: Dialectica was co-founded in 2015 by George Tsarouchas (CEO) and Frederick Corkett. Both founders had backgrounds in management consulting and the expert network industry — Tsarouchas at Goldman Sachs and the buy-side, Corkett at AMR International as a strategy consultant and previously at AlphaSights. They started the company in Athens, Greece with a small sales office in London, deliberately choosing Athens for its talent pool and cost advantages. The firm grew rapidly, earning a place on the FT 1000 (Europe's fastest-growing companies) for five consecutive years and crossing $100 million in revenue by 2025.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Calls
servicesDetailed.description: Dialectica's core offering: one-on-one and multi-party consultations with custom-sourced experts. The firm emphasizes high curation quality — a 1,000+ strong operations team based primarily in Athens manages expert sourcing, scheduling, and compliance. Dialectica's operational model delivers comparable quality to premium peers at competitive pricing through its Athens cost base.

servicesDetailed.name: B2B Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: Scalable B2B surveys sourced through Dialectica's expert network and broader respondent panels. Surveys are designed for market sizing, competitive benchmarking, customer sentiment, and pricing studies. Can be paired with follow-up expert calls for deeper exploration.

servicesDetailed.name: Insights (Content Library)
servicesDetailed.description: Dialectica's content library of expert-sourced transcripts, analysis pieces, and research deliverables. The Insights platform provides reusable research content that clients can access on demand, increasingly enriched by AI-powered synthesis and the Dialectica IQ knowledge graph.

servicesDetailed.name: Origin (Deal Sourcing Platform)
servicesDetailed.description: A self-service deal-sourcing and market intelligence platform built for private equity, venture capital, and corporate strategy teams. Origin provides expert-vetted company snapshots, qualitative deal intelligence, and CRM integration. It targets workflow budgets currently allocated to deal-sourcing databases by offering the 'critical context that data tables miss.' Origin represents Dialectica's push beyond traditional expert calls into structured data products.

servicesDetailed.name: Custom Research
servicesDetailed.description: Multi-method research engagements combining expert calls, surveys, content, and custom analysis into structured deliverables. Designed for due diligence, market landscape assessments, and complex strategic questions requiring multiple expert perspectives and dedicated project management.

aiPlatform.narrative: Dialectica has made AI a central part of its identity and growth strategy. The firm positions itself as 'redefining how knowledge is discovered, indexed, and synthesized' through its Dialectica IQ knowledge graph — a dynamic, continuously evolving system that structures the world's business knowledge. The firm operates with 50+ advanced GenAI tools, proprietary AI agents, and a team of 120+ technology and data professionals. Datasets are enriched by a 1,000+ strong operations team, combining human intelligence with AI at scale. The AI platform minimizes the time from query to actionable insight.

complianceExtended.narrative: Dialectica has significantly invested in compliance infrastructure as it scales into larger institutional accounts. In 2025, the firm hired the former Chief Compliance Officer at Tegus to lead its legal and regulatory program — a notable signal of investment in this area. The firm uses technology-assisted vetting combined with human compliance review, and its proprietary AI tools include automated compliance monitoring capabilities. As a newer entrant (founded 2015), Dialectica's compliance infrastructure is less battle-tested than incumbents like GLG or Guidepoint, but the Tegus CCO hire suggests the firm is actively closing this gap.

clientFit.narrative: Dialectica is especially well suited for clients who want premium-quality expert interactions at competitive pricing. The firm's Athens-based operational model delivers high curation quality while maintaining cost advantages over London and New York-based competitors. Origin makes it particularly strong for PE deal teams. The firm's European roots give it a natural advantage in European and emerging market research.
